form.label: Correlation 3 Sources
form.description: Find an entity across THREE data sources and measure how wide its footprint is (2-of-3 vs 3-of-3).

search.query: | rest /services/data/indexes | search (title=london_* OR title=berlin_* OR title=loc1_*) | table title | sort title
| rest /services/data/indexes | search (title=london_* OR title=berlin_* OR title=loc1_*) | table title | sort title
| rest /services/data/indexes | search (title=london_* OR title=berlin_* OR title=loc1_*) | table title | sort title

html.p: Same idea as the two-source page, extended to three. For each $key$ (service / user / host) we count events in $srcA$, $srcB$ and $srcC$, then compute in how many of the three it appears — its footprint.

ul.li: Sources = 3 → the entity is active everywhere (green rows).
Sources = 2 → active in two of the three (amber) — a partial footprint.

html.p: Why it matters: correlating across more sources turns scattered logs into a single picture. A user or service showing up across three systems at once is exactly what a single dashboard could never reveal. The exact search is shown at the bottom.

search.query: (index=$srcA$ OR index=$srcB$ OR index=$srcC$) | rex field=_raw "\s(?<service>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_\-./]*)(?:\[\d+\])?:\s" | rex field=_raw "(?i)(?:user[=:\s]+|for\s+)(?<user>[A-Za-z0-9_.\-$]+)" | eval src=case(index=="$srcA$","A",index=="$srcB$","B",index=="$srcC$","C") | stats count(eval(src=="A")) as A, count(eval(src=="B")) as B, count(eval(src=="C")) as C by $key$ | eval sp=(if(A>0,1,0)+if(B>0,1,0)+if(C>0,1,0)) | where sp==3 | stats count as all_three

panel.title: Events over time — all three sources

search.query: (index=$srcA$ OR index=$srcB$ OR index=$srcC$) | timechart span=5m count by index

panel.title: Correlation matrix — $key$ across the three sources (2-of-3 and 3-of-3)

search.query: (index=$srcA$ OR index=$srcB$ OR index=$srcC$) | rex field=_raw "\s(?<service>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_\-./]*)(?:\[\d+\])?:\s" | rex field=_raw "(?i)(?:user[=:\s]+|for\s+)(?<user>[A-Za-z0-9_.\-$]+)" | eval src=case(index=="$srcA$","A",index=="$srcB$","B",index=="$srcC$","C") | stats count(eval(src=="A")) as A_events, count(eval(src=="B")) as B_events, count(eval(src=="C")) as C_events, min(_time) as first, max(_time) as last by $key$ | eval Sources=(if(A_events>0,1,0)+if(B_events>0,1,0)+if(C_events>0,1,0)) | where Sources>=2 | eval "First seen"=strftime(first,"%F %T"), "Last seen"=strftime(last,"%F %T") | rename A_events as "$srcA$", B_events as "$srcB$", C_events as "$srcC$" | table $key$ Sources "$srcA$" "$srcB$" "$srcC$" "First seen" "Last seen" | sort - Sources - "$srcA$"

html.pre: (index=$srcA$ OR index=$srcB$ OR index=$srcC$) | eval src=case(index=="$srcA$","A",index=="$srcB$","B",index=="$srcC$","C") | stats count(eval(src=="A")) as A, count(eval(src=="B")) as B, count(eval(src=="C")) as C by $key$ | eval Sources = (if(A>0,1,0)+if(B>0,1,0)+if(C>0,1,0)) | where Sources>=2 * 3 = seen everywhere, 2 = partial footprint
